title: Conjugating a prime-power subgroup into a fixed Sylow subgroup
statement: Let $G$ be a finite group, $p$ a prime, $P\leq G$ a subgroup of $p$-power order, and $L\leq G$ a $p$-Sylow subgroup, that is, $L$ has $p$-power order and $[G:L]$ is prime to $p$. Then there exists $g\in G$ such that $gPg^{-1}\subseteq L$. Finiteness refers to the underlying set, in the sense of [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set].
